steps.content: The crowds have mostly dispersed now. You bid farewell to the residents of Bloomfete Street and see off the visitors from DisCity.
Finally, following the trail of flower fragrance, you return to the Wisteria Pavilion.
The ladies open the gate for you, teasing you playfully before patting your shoulder and ushering you into the courtyard. Then, their figures fade away like shadows in the night.
The wisteria tree stands as usual before you, its flowers in full bloom, yet no one sits among its branches.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've said goodbye to everyone else. You're the only one left.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There's still some time left. I can let you borrow some of my Qi. Come out to see me, will you?
The only response is the whisper of flower petals falling in the wind.

You walk to the wisteria tree and sit by its roots. Drowsiness washes over you gradually—perhaps it's her secretly draining your Qi, or maybe you're simply exhausted after completing your mission and spending the whole night at the fete. Your eyelids grow heavy.
You recall your first visit to this courtyard—just like now, you sat beneath this tree, quickly fell asleep, and then you met her.
The thought brings an inexplicable sense of ease. You gaze at the wisteria blossoms and begin to speak, as if talking to yourself.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This place is truly remarkable. It's different from what I imagined, and different from what Yugu wrote about too.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You and the locals here are all pretty interesting—like spirits but also so human. You've shown me so much of what everyday life is like in Eastia.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Yugu couldn't have made all this up, could she? She'd never appreciate such simple joys. I still can't figure out how the two of you ended up together.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...You said this was your fete. I'm wondering... are you a Sinner too?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No response? Then I'll take that as a yes.

Outside, the faint chatter of the Eastian spirits reaches your ears. The wisteria vines sway gently—they must be following their traditions, collecting the wish tags visitors had tied to the branches. Quite the undertaking, you imagine.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Were you all in DisCity? Inside that giant Mania tree?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: After the farewell on the fourth day, are you returning to Eastia? Where exactly? Even the scholars there can't seem to locate you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: How about letting my shackles connect to you? Then I could go visit you.
Gradually, even the voices of the locals fade away. The night deepens, and a light purple mist settles around you.
She hasn't come, but the wisteria tree keeps you company, silently listening as you drift between sleep and waking, murmuring in your half-dreams.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I have to admit, I had a great time. It was a joyous fete, and I could see the people of DisCity enjoying themselves too.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Will you come back next year?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you promise not to harm anyone anymore, I think people would love to come visit again.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're right. Maybe we're not so different after all...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Perhaps by next year, I'll find a wish of my own...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Wish you a good new year...
The rich floral fragrance envelops you like a warm blanket, finally lulling you into a peaceful slumber.
...A good new year...
In your last moments of consciousness, something soft brushes against your cheek, or perhaps the tip of your nose, or maybe even the corner of your lips.
Like a kiss as light as a flower petal.
(Fade to white)

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: The outlander extends a hand, yearning to seize the hazy silhouette, craving words unspoken, longing for a final glimpse of her face—　　　　　 And so the dream finally ends.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: In a daze, you catch sight of a familiar face, just as she appeared when you first met.
[Scene Change]

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: However, it is not Yingying.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: ...Chief? Thank goodness you woke up too! Are you feeling any discomfort?

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Those at your bedside are your trusted companions—you have returned to your real world. You may now find ease.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: ...I'm fine, everything's good. I just didn't expect to return at this time...

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Did my Qi get drained up again?

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Don't be silly! You're in perfect shape—you just got plenty of rest! Why don't you head to the command center?

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: The FAC officers have been waiting for you for a while.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Indeed, they have been awaiting your arrival. The team stands ready, their spirits high as they present you with a thick stack of operation plans.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: The arboreal Mania entity continues to expand, with internal contamination reaching critical levels—it's on the verge of going berserk. However, we've successfully quarantined the contaminated zone and found our opening!

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: We've pinpointed the contamination center's coordinates, and our frontline units are assembled and ready for deployment. We're only waiting for your orders now, Chief!

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Yes! We got duped, but we still managed to find a clue in that illusion. Those vines crawling over the streets—they spread just like Mania in the real world. Turns out, the wisteria trees are the very source of the contamination.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: We've also confirmed another major pollution hub at the coordinates where the Rust sits. High frequency spectrum of Mania detected. Looks like a highly-contaminated Sinner is holed up there, and she's likely the root of all this pollution.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: The contamination source... are we going to eliminate it?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: What about the hostages? All those affected civilians?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Don't worry, Chief. Everyone has regained consciousness. Before you woke up, all the trapped victims had already been freed from the "fete," and they are now recovering quickly, both physically and mentally. The civilians in the contaminated area have been fully evacuated—we can now act without restraint.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: We've heard back from Eastia as well. Based on our encounters at the fete, they've verified the complete story behind the "fete" and offered plenty of recommendations. We can now attempt to tackle that monster.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: An urgent letter from Eastia is delivered into your hands.
[Display an image of the fete]

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: In Eastia, stories of New Year fetes and millennium-old wisteria trees are quite common, though only a few were ever documented. With countless adaptations and revisions over time... it's difficult to trace the original legend.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: However, this wish-making ceremony you mentioned is quite interesting.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: In ancient traditions, shooting stars were commonly seen as omens of misfortune. The practice of wishing upon them came later, influenced by foreign cultures. This suggests that the "fete" you experienced is relatively recent—likely within the past two centuries.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Based on details provided such as dietary customs, we can trace it to a certain frontier region. Combined with the economic impact of distant wars and the early-blooming wisteria due to climate change, we can estimate this occurred during the chaotic times around the Nightfall.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Following these clues, we investigated several ruins where no descendants remained, and examined fragmentary written records. Among them, we stumbled upon a local chronicle about an unnamed fete where, on its third day, people witnessed a rare auspicious shooting star.
[Small CG - Shooting Star at the Fete]

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: The records of that fete end there, leaving us in the dark about what followed. However, by translating between the old and new calendars, we can determine that the fete's third day fell on an unspecified date in the first year of the Nightfall.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: That celebrated shooting star, recorded as an auspicious omen...
[Small CG - Perishing Star]

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: It was the <color=#fb9259>Perishing Star</color>.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: ...And so it was.　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 They say, the millennium-old wisteria fete, revered for centuries, was ravaged overnight by the calamity the ominous star brought forth. How many dreams turned to dust, how many hopes lay entombed in its wake.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: However, perhaps this was destined.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: When the storm comes, never a single nest survives unscathed. In a world ever so cruel, how can any paradise endure?　　　　　　　　　　　　 These moments of joy are mere fortune's accidents, illusions in the void. Everything shall return to its fated end, and that... is the ultimate truth I seek.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Still, I must thank you all. Your contributions to the third volume have truly breathed new life into these pages.　　　　　　　　　　 Those distant souls I could never quite reach now shine with such vibrant charm.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Therefore, when devastation arrives, it shall be all the more heart-swaying. That... is the ultimate beauty I seek.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Through my tales, they shall transcend into eternity.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: And so, dear audience, the tale of the Hazy Fete draws its last stroke.　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 As the mist disperses, the threads of destiny woven through centuries finally culminate. And you shall bear witness to its final chapter.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Together... let us behold what fate unfolds.
